required_missing_evidence: Evidence of ulceration or invasive-looking surface change would strengthen the exclusion of BCC.

why_it_matters: A definitive diagnosis requires histopathological confirmation, which can provide crucial details about the cellular structure and characteristics of the lesion.
impact_on_differential: Without biopsy results, it is impossible to rule out malignancy definitively, keeping Squamous Cell Carcinoma (SCC) and Basal Cell Carcinoma (BCC) in the differential.
